name: WF-313 — Dynamic MAO → Property-Level Offer Strategy & Acquisition Decision

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const dynamic=input.dynamic_mao??deal.dynamic_mao??{}; const mao=Number(dynamic.adjusted_mao??deal.adjusted_mao??deal.dynamic_mao); const asking=Number(deal.asking_price??deal.list_price??deal.current_price); const projectedProfit=Number(deal.projected_assignment_profit??deal.assignment_profit??deal.projected_net_profit??0); const motivation=String(deal.motivation_level??deal.motivation??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const assetType=String(dynamic.asset_type??deal.asset_type??deal.property_type??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const blockers=Array.isArray(deal.blockers)?deal.blockers:[]; const evidenceReady=deal.evidence_complete!==false; const identityReady=Boolean(deal.deal_id??deal.id); const validNumbers=Number.isFinite(mao)&&Number.isFinite(asking)&&Number.isFinite(projectedProfit); let decision='needs_evidence'; let reason='insufficient evidence'; if(blockers.length){decision='blocked';reason='active blockers';}else if(!identityReady||!evidenceReady){decision='needs_evidence';reason='identity or evidence incomplete';}else if(!validNumbers||mao<=0){decision='needs_evidence';reason='invalid underwriting inputs';}else if(asking<=mao&&projectedProfit>0){decision='pursue';reason='asking price is at or below dynamic MAO with positive projected profit';}else if(asking>mao&&asking<=mao*1.10&&projectedProfit>0&&motivation!=='low'){decision='negotiate';reason='asking price is within controlled negotiation band';}else if(projectedProfit<=0||asking>mao*1.10){decision='pass';reason=projectedProfit<=0?'projected profit is not positive':'asking price exceeds controlled negotiation band';} const strategy=assetType.includes('land')?'land-specific economics':assetType.includes('multi')?'multifamily-specific economics':'residential wholesale economics'; const status=decision==='blocked'?'blocked':decision==='needs_evidence'?'evidence_required':'decision_ready'; const offerStrategy={decision,reason,asking_price:asking,dynamic_mao:mao,projected_assignment_profit:projectedProfit,motivation,asset_type:assetType,strategy,ma_rule:'secondary_reference_only',economics_priority:'asset_specific_first',negotiation_ceiling:mao}; return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-313',workflow_name:'Dynamic MAO → Property-Level Offer Strategy & Acquisition Decision',status,acquisition_decision:decision,offer_strategy:offerStrategy,next_workflow:decision==='pursue'||decision==='negotiate'?'WF-314':decision==='pass'?'WF-315':decision==='blocked'?'WF-126':'WF-312',crm_activity:{activity_type:'property_level_offer_strategy',deal_id:deal.deal_id??deal.id,status,offer_strategy:offerStrategy}}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { workflow_id: $json.workflow_id, status: $json.status, acquisition_decision: $json.acquisition_decision, next_workflow: $json.next_workflow, offer_strategy: $json.offer_strategy, crm_persisted: true } }}

meta.description: Converts dynamic MAO and deal evidence into a property-level acquisition decision and offer strategy.
